about_the_game:
Boblin Goblin must set traps in his islands dungeons in order to defend against the invading adventurers! As the goblins on the island are to weak to fight back against dangerous foes like paladins and rogues, Boblin must place traps and lure enemies in order to secure his and his fellow goblin islanders safety. Explore a fun and unique pixel art world as you journey from your home island to protecting the whole land. Protect your fellow goblins and your islands! 

Key Features:

  • Trapsetter is an arcade adventure with light roguelike elements. Featuring randomized room dungeons, each playthrough is different.

  • Set different traps, such as bear traps, tripwires, wooden spikes, and more, each with a unique effect! 

  • Over 30+ enemies inspired from classic fantasy such as paladins, rogues, dwarves and more!

  • Fight 7 unique bosses!

  • Collect over 25+ of items to give your traps and Boblin power ups!

  • 5 major sections of the overworld to explore each with 2 to 4 dungeons!
